concerns.text: Task T002 adds a `is_semantically_distinct` flag and later T007 restricts the rare‑event subset to `is_rare AND is_semantically_distinct`. This narrows the definition of “rare events” beyond FR‑012 (which only requires ≤ 5 occurrences), effectively weakening the functional requirement and may cause the long‑term analysis to abort even when ≥ 30 rare events exist per the spec.
The rare‑event filter introduced in T002 is reused here, causing the same weakening of FR‑012 and potentially violating SC‑001 (which expects a measurable improvement on the full rare‑event set).

The `assemble_report` task produces `evaluation_report.json` that conforms to the schema, but the schema (and thus the report) lacks fields for the baseline long‑term accuracy or the percentage improvement required by SC‑001. Consequently the required improvement metric is never computed or reported.
FR‑008 (memory usage ≤ 7 GB) and SC‑005 (measure memory footprint) are not addressed by any verification step. No task records RAM consumption during the pipeline, leaving the constraint unchecked.

The description of T002 references a “Phase 0.4” (semantic distinctness computation) which is not defined in the implementation plan (`plan.md`). This creates an internal inconsistency and should be clarified or removed.
